scope: Bounded targeted current-mechanism experiment, not a canonical integrated trial or player-guided/full-rule acceptance.

policy.selection: All attempted seeds retained; first swimming offspring archived, not a guarantee or ordinary frequency claim.
policy.interventions: Two adult founders placed in supported existing habitat; no additional food, forced acceptance, repeated cooldown reset, accelerated gestation, editor, final-trait injection or mutation boost.
policy.limitation: Current neutral core/parental and supported-water rules. Tissue costs, a current-policy mature descendant branch and ordinary player-guided trial acceptance remain unproven. Historical legacy-rule outputs are retained in the parent directory.

rows.scope: Two disclosed adult non-player founding organisms; ordinary resources, one conception attempt, normal gestation, no mutation-rate/editor/trait intervention.
